name: pampa-store-publisher
description: Repo-local MCP plugin that browses, manages, and publishes Android APK releases for the Pampa Store.

interface.shortDescription: Browse the catalog, inspect apps and releases, edit store files, and publish Android APK releases
interface.longDescription: Use this repo-local MCP plugin to inspect the Pampa Store catalog, read and write repository files, manage catalog entries, inspect releases, and publish or dry-run Android APK releases while keeping app manifests and the central store index aligned.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the Pampa Store apps, inspect the current app version and releases, then dry-run or publish the next APK release when everything looks correct
